failure_mode: Partially resolved — only the singular getLigandsByUniprot endpoint still hangs
root_cause: The earlier 'all endpoints hang' diagnosis was too broad. Re-verified: getLigandsByUniprots, getLigandsByPDBs and getTargetByCompound all answer HTTP 200 in ~100 ms. Only the singular /getLigandsByUniprot (no trailing 's') still fails to respond within 60 s. The apparent total outage was compounded by a client-side defect: the tool sent plural query-parameter names (uniprots=/pdbs=) where BindingDB's spec documents singular ones (uniprot=/pdb=), which makes the server return an empty result set (uniprot) or HTTP 500 (pdb).
retry_notes: Only the singular endpoint remains unreachable. Try GET https://www.bindingdb.org/rest/getLigandsByUniprot?uniprot=P35354;100&response=application/json — if it responds within 60s that endpoint is back. The plural endpoints are already in use by bindingdb_tool.py and need no retry.
workaround: bindingdb_tool.py routes every operation through the plural getLigandsByUniprots endpoint, which works. No external substitute is required.
